stepName: GLP Recipe Guide Follow Up Scripts
title: How to follow up with your GLP-1 Recipe Guide leads
titleHtml: How to follow up with your GLP-1 Recipe Guide leads
sub: Use these scripts immediately after receiving a new recipe guide lead.

video.title: Funnel scripts training video
video.caption: Watch this before you start calling.

steps.title: Call them
steps.lead: They probably won't pick up, so leave this voicemail:
script: I saw you requested our free GLP-1 recipe guide. I'm going to text you the link now so you have it handy and can check out all the recipes.

Also, since you're looking for ways to support your daily nutrition while taking a GLP-1, I can send you some info on a supplement I've been really excited about lately. It's designed to help support daily nutrient and essential wellness needs while you're on a GLP-1.
If you're curious about it, just reply back to my text and I'll send you the details. No pressure at all!

If you don't see my text, check your Unknown Senders or Spam folder. On an iPhone, look for the filter or menu icon in the top right corner of your Messages app. On an Android, look for the three-dot menu. You should be able to find any filtered messages there, which is where my text might be.
Okay, that's all for now! Let me know if you got the text. Talk soon!

steps.title: Text them
steps.lead: As soon as you hang up, send this:
script: Hey [Name], it's [Your Name]! 👋 Just left you a quick voicemail. Here's the link to the GLP-1 recipe guide you requested so you have it handy:

Also, quick question - are you doing anything to make sure you're still getting the nutrients your body needs while taking a GLP-1? I've been sharing something with people that makes supporting those daily nutrition needs really simple.
If you're curious, just reply INFO and I'll send you the info!

steps.title: Follow up in 24 hrs
steps.lead: If they don't respond within 24 hours, text again:
script: [Name]! Just following up on the above! 👆 Were you able to get the recipe guide? Want some info on the supplement I mentioned that helps support daily nutrient and wellness needs while on a GLP-1? Shoot me a text back - I can hook you up!

tip: Tip: Personalize [Name] and [Your Name] every time. The recipe guide link is already in the text script - just hit Copy script and send it as-is.
footer: GLP-1 Recipe Guide follow-up · Quick reference · Keep this handy by your phone
